title: Tim Knight Says SpaceX Is Tracking the Facebook IPO Almost Exactly
speaker: Tim Knight (Slope of Hope) with tastylive hosts

macro_themes.view: Nasdaq strong and bullish, S&P near a continuation breakout, Dow in a bear market since Aug 5.

macro_themes.theme: No bear market until AI IPOs
macro_themes.view: No meaningful bear move until next year, after the Anthropic and OpenAI IPOs are done or scuttled.
Bonds (ZB) keep sinking and the euro is breaking down; rate-sensitive stocks like homebuilders suffer.

calls.condition: Something is wrong if it sinks below the breakout level / Friday's low
calls.reason: Bullish continuation basing pattern since June, no overhead supply, five green bars in a row.
calls.quote: the INQ is the powerhouse and this is the bulls market to lose

calls.condition: Bullish continuation if ES pushes above recent highs; bear market only next year after AI IPOs
calls.reason: Close to forming a continuation pattern but needs more lifting; no meaningful bear move until next year.
calls.quote: there's not going to be any bare market until uh several things get out of the way

calls.reason: Dow peaked Aug 5 and has been in a bear market, down even on an up day.
calls.quote: the Dow 30, which peaked way back on August 5th and has just been just blah blah blur bare market

calls.reason: Escaped the $150 range (cheerleading short term), but tracking the Facebook post-IPO path: a new drawdown phase to ~110-120 in coming months, then a leap higher next year; lockup of 28% on Nov 9.
calls.quote: I could see this grinding from the months ahead to like I don't know, pick a number 110, 120, some nasty new period.

calls.reason: Steady descent; homebuilder hurt by rising rates and reports of an affiliate buying its unsold homes.
calls.quote: one of my shorts now which is having uh last I checked a good day today ... is LAR the home builder

notes: Tim says 'today is the 5th' (Monday 2026-10-05). SpaceX target 115 is the midpoint of his '110, 120'; price 170 is his 'let's say' figure. 'INQ'/'LAR'/'Lenar' are transcription of NQ/Lennar. Co-host says he holds a long call zebra (2x 70 long, 1x 75 short, June) on what appears to be Lennar, contradicting Tim; not recorded. ZB bonds and euro weakness described, no separate call.
